What's New in Loop Workspace

Release 8.4 — January 2026

  • Channels: Pinned message limit raised from 100 to 250 per channel.
  • Loop Assist: Thread summarization is now available in all paid workspaces. Loop Assist summarizes long threads on demand and drafts reply suggestions. Assist is read-only: it cannot post, delete, or modify messages, and it cannot act without a user pressing send.
  • Huddles: Live captions available in 12 additional languages.
  • Compliance: Legal hold now covers files shared in direct messages.

Release 8.3 — December 2025

  • Loop Assist: Added workspace-level toggle to disable Assist entirely.
  • Search: Improved relevance ranking for file attachments.
  • Enterprise Key Management: Key rotation interval is now configurable.

Release 8.2 — November 2025

  • Apps: New app directory review process for third-party integrations.
  • Mobile: Offline draft support on iOS.
